article.title: Attention Economy Navigator – October 2026 w/Evan Greer
article.author: Cayden Mak
article.content: This week we are building our Attention Economy Navigator for the month of October 2026. It’s our guide to what you should be paying more attention to, and what you can probably pay less attention to. And why those stories might not be what you’d assume. Joining to help build this month’s Attention Economy Navigator in real time are Director at Fight for the Future, Evan Greer and Senior… Source
